body_markdown:
GARLAND, TX (May 6, 2026) — Massimo has opened pre-orders and initial dealer orders for the new Sentinel 770 HVAC, the latest addition to the Sentinel HVAC line.


The Sentinel 770 HVAC builds on the Sentinel 570 HVAC and keeps the line's goal: a fully enclosed cab with factory-integrated heating and cooling at a price below $20,000. Comparable HVAC-equipped UTVs from other brands are often priced above $30,000.


Both Sentinel models feature:


- Fully enclosed cabins with integrated heating and cooling
- Upgraded molded seating
- Dual touchscreen displays
- Independent cooling, so you can pre-cool the cabin remotely before you head out


"The Sentinel 570 HVAC helped validate demand for premium, climate-controlled UTVs at a more accessible price point, and the launch of the Sentinel 770 HVAC gives our dealers another compelling product to serve both consumer and commercial buyers," said Quenton Petersen, CEO of Massimo.
